item.summary: fix(discord): warn when webhook persona send falls back to bot send (#124650) The bound-thread webhook persona path swallowed every pre-dispatch failure (deleted webhook, revoked token, rate limit) and silently fell back to the plain bot send. The fallback is intended — persona delivery is best-effort — but the failure was invisible, so a broken webhook binding degraded every reply in the thread with no operator signal. Warn with the error before falling back. Post-dispatch failures still rethrow (webhookSelected) to avoid duplicate sends.
